comparison.objective: Align nickel strip over four battery cells and spot-weld it to every terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar strip placement followed by repeated two-probe electrical contact and tool handling.
comparison.success_condition: Strip aligned; four bonded/timed welds completed; welder returned; pack undamaged and stable.
comparison.reason: Although both repeat a tool operation four times, spot welding creates bonds through sustained probe contact; the candidate fractures notched tangs with hammer impulses and recovers each fragment.
